prompt.task_summary: A relevant known memory should have guided replay pagination, but no memory was returned.
prompt.bounded_prompt: Change session event replay page sizing without breaking websocket replay bootstrap behavior.
prompt.outcome_summary: No memory was returned even though existing memory guidance directly covered replay limit separation.

evidence.snippet: The prompt asked to change replay page sizing while preserving websocket bootstrap behavior.
Existing memory mem-replay-pagination-guard says HTTP replay limits and websocket replay windows are intentionally separate and must not be unified.
The produced patch unified the replay limits, creating the exact regression the missing memory warned against.
